title: HOLISMOKES -- XVIII. Cosmology with strongly lensed type II supernovae: Effects of instrumental setups on $H_0$
summary: The upcoming Rubin Observatory and subsequent follow-up observations should improve the determination of the Hubble constant ($H_0$) via time-delay cosmography of strongly lensed type II supernovae (LSNe II), by enabling the detection of many more such events. In our previous work, we developed a method for determining the supernova (SN) phase from spectral absorption features. Because obtaining spectra of faint targets such as distant SN II is expensive, we examined how low-resolution spectra influence the precision of time-delay retrieval, and consequently the precision on $H_0$. We considered spectral resolutions $R = \fracλ{Δλ}$ between 100 and 250, and we investigated three signal-to-noise ratio ($S/N$) values of 10, 15, and 20, for each resolution. Furthermore, we forecast the precision on $H_{0}$ achievable with $S/N=10$ and compared the observing time required to reach it with ground-based and space-based facilities. We find that the time delay can be determined without bias and with uncertainties as low as 1.3 days for the investigated resolutions and $S/N$ values when we combine time-delay measurements of multiple absorption lines. For a typical LSN II system (absolute magnitude $\sim-$17 mag in the rest-frame V band, source redshift of \zs = 0.8), the required exposure times range from multiple hours for ground-based observations to a few minutes for space-based observations with the JWST. Our predictions on the precision of $H_0$ for a single lensed SN range from 14.2\% for $R = 100$ and $S/N$ = 10 to 7.5\% for $R = 250$ and $S/N$ = 20, enabling a 1\% determination of $H_0$ from $\sim$20 lensed SNe in the coming years.

title: SERENADE III: Insight into the Origin of the High Dust Temperature and High [O III]/[C II] Ratio at $z\gtrsim6$
summary: We present an analysis of ALMA high-frequency observations of nine bright Lyman-break galaxies at $5.8<z_{\rm spec}<8.3$. Our sample consists of five galaxies at $z\sim6$ newly observed in Band-9 and/or 10, allowing us to better constrain the dust temperature ($T_{\rm dust}$) in a statistical sample of $z\gtrsim6$ galaxies. Our measurements of the dust temperature at $z\sim6-9$ suggest most of the star-forming galaxies show $T_{\rm dust}\sim40\,{\rm K}$ on average, whereas three galaxies show significantly higher $T_{\rm dust}$ ($\gtrsim60\,{\rm K}$). We find a potential negative correlation between $T_{\rm dust}$ and gas-phase metallicity with $T_{\rm dust}\propto Z^{-0.50\pm0.19}$, implying decreased dust shielding and efficient dust heating in low-metallicity environments. Given the systematic offset of $T_{\rm dust}$ between $z\sim0$ and $z\sim6-9$ at fixed metallicity, we find $T_{\rm dust}$ is well described by sSFR as well as $Z$ with $\log T_{\rm dust}=-0.25^{+0.03}_{-0.04}\times(\log Z-0.57\times\log {\rm sSFR})+4.88^{+0.47}_{-0.43}$ across $z\sim0$ to $z\sim6-9$. Simultaneously with the dust continuum, these observations cover the [OI]63$μ$m emission line for five galaxies, which traces dense neutral gas. We find a lower [CII]/[OI] ratio in $z\gtrsim6$ galaxies than in local samples, suggesting that [CII] becomes fainter due to collisional de-excitation at high gas density. Combining the [OI], [OIII], and [CII] lines and cloudy modeling, our results imply $\log U_{\rm ion}\sim-2$ and $\log n_{\rm H}\,[{\rm cm}^{-3}]\sim2.5$ in $z\gtrsim6$ galaxies, which is $\sim3-10\times$ higher $U_{\rm ion}$ and $\sim2-3\times$ higher $n_{\rm H}$ than the local samples. The combination of these enhanced $U_{\rm ion}$ and $n_{\rm H}$ naturally explains the high [OIII]/[CII] ratio at $z\gtrsim6$.

title: COSMOS-Web: From early star-formation enhancement to late suppression in galaxy groups
summary: Galaxy groups trace dense environments where interactions, gas removal, and reduced accretion may drive quenching. Common diagnostics trace star formation over short timescales ($\lesssim 100$ Myr), so time-resolved star formation histories (SFHs) are needed to separate brief changes from longer-term evolution at fixed mass and redshift. Using COSMOS-Web data, we test how group environment correlates with star formation, how this evolves with cosmic time and group-centric distance, and how high-richness group galaxies differ from field galaxies. We combine COSMOS2025/COSMOS-Web stellar masses and non-parametric SFHs with AMICO group detections and probabilistic memberships. Using stacked SFHs and evolution diagnostics, we compare group and matched field galaxies as a function of normalized group-centric distance ($R_{\rm norm}$), using the richest groups as reference. The clearest suppression appears at $z<1.5$ and low-to-intermediate mass ($8.1<\log(M_\star/M_\odot)<10.5$), reaching a group-field SFH deficit up to 0.8 dex. At $z>1.5$, SFHs show weak suppression or occasional enhancement, a more heterogeneous contrast despite possible systematics. The radial signal also evolves: low-redshift profiles are broadly quenching-oriented across radius, while a clear inner-outer contrast emerges at $z\gtrsim 1$, though ordering at $z\gtrsim 2$ remains tentative given growing uncertainty in AMICO centroids. These results suggest an evolving picture: at early epochs groups are more mixed, with both suppressed and elevated SFHs; from $z\lesssim 1.5$, suppression dominates, most clearly for low-to-intermediate-mass galaxies. This fits inner-region galaxies spending more time within the group potential, undergoing more passages through dense intra-group regions, and receiving less pristine cold gas, making quenching progressively clearer with cosmic time.

AI.tldr: 本文利用COSMOS-Web数据结合非参数恒星形成历史（SFH）和AMICO星系群检测，系统研究了星系群环境对恒星形成的影响。发现最明显的恒星形成抑制出现在z<1.5、低到中等质量（8.1<log M*<10.5）的星系中，群-场SFH差距可达0.8 dex；而z>1.5时抑制较弱甚至出现增强。径向信号也随红移演化，低红移时抑制贯穿整个半径范围，z≳1时出现内外对比。整体呈现随宇宙时间演化的图景：早期星系群环境混杂，z≲1.5后抑制逐渐主导。
AI.motivation: 传统恒星形成诊断只能追踪短时间尺度（≲100 Myr）的恒星形成活动，无法区分短暂变化与长期演化。需要在固定质量和红移条件下，利用时间分辨的恒星形成历史来分离星系群环境对恒星形成的短期扰动与长期淬灭效应。
AI.method: 结合COSMOS2025/COSMOS-Web的恒星质量与非参数SFH数据，使用AMICO星系群检测和概率成员判定，通过叠加SFH和演化诊断，将星系群成员与匹配的场星系进行比较，并按照归一化群心距（R_norm）和星系群富度进行分层分析。
AI.result: 在z<1.5和低到中等质量范围内观测到最清晰的恒星形成抑制，群-场SFH差距最高达0.8 dex。z>1.5时抑制较弱或出现偶尔增强，对比更加异质。径向剖面的演化表现为：低红移时抑制贯通全半径，而z≳1时出现内外区域明显对比，z≳2时由于AMICO质心不确定性增大导致排序仍不确定。
AI.conclusion: 星系群环境对恒星形成的影响随宇宙时间演化：早期星系群环境混杂，同时存在抑制和增强的SFH；从z≲1.5开始抑制占据主导，尤其对低到中等质量星系最明显。这符合内区星系在群势阱中停留时间更长、经历更多致密群内区域穿行、接收更少原始冷气体的物理图像，使淬灭随宇宙时间逐渐清晰。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Schematic illustration of the migration-vector formalism anchored to \(t_{50}\) . The vector is defined in the log–log \(M_{\star}\mbox{--}\textrm{SFR}\) plane between the galaxy state at \(t_{50}\) , when 50% of the final stellar mass has formed, and the observed state \(t_{{now}}\) , corresponding to \(t_{{lb}}=0\) . Its Cartesian components are given by \(\Delta\log M_{\star}\) and \(\Delta\log{SFR}\) , its orientation is quantified by \(\Phi_{50}=\arctan(\Delta\log{SFR}/\Delta\log M_{\star})\) , and its amplitude by \(r_{50}\times t_{50}=\sqrt{(\Delta\log M_{\star})^{2}+(\Delta\log{SFR})^{2}}\) . Positive \(\Phi_{50}\) corresponds to recent evolution toward higher SFR at fixed mass growth, while negative \(\Phi_{50}\) corresponds to declining recent SFR relative to mass growth.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：锚定于 \(t_{50}\) 的迁移矢量形式体系的示意图。该矢量定义在对数-对数 \(M_{\star}\mbox{--}\textrm{SFR}\) 平面中，连接 \(t_{50}\) 时刻（即最终恒星质量形成50%时）的星系状态与观测状态 \(t_{{now}}\) （对应 \(t_{{lb}}=0\) ）。其笛卡尔分量由 \(\Delta\log M_{\star}\) 和 \(\Delta\log{SFR}\) 给出，方向由 \(\Phi_{50}=\arctan(\Delta\log{SFR}/\Delta\log M_{\star})\) 量化，幅度由 \(r_{50}\times t_{50}=\sqrt{(\Delta\log M_{\star})^{2}+(\Delta\log{SFR})^{2}}\) 给出。正的 \(\Phi_{50}\) 对应于在固定质量增长下近期向更高SFR演化的趋势，而负的 \(\Phi_{50}\) 对应于相对于质量增长的近期SFR下降。

The comparison is restricted to galaxies within the peak-centered 68% angular interval around the negative \(\Phi_{50}\) peak, so the figure isolates populations with recent declining SFHs over the last half-mass assembly phase of each galaxy. Thus, \(\Delta r_{50}>0\) ( \(<0\) ) indicates faster (slower) declining SFHs in groups than in the matched field.

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Spatial distribution of galaxies in the top-30 richest groups at different redshift bins, shown in normalized group-centric coordinates ( \(R_{{norm}}\) ). Scatter points mark individual galaxies and are color-coded by \(\Phi_{50}\) , which traces the recent SFH evolution over the last half-mass assembly phase of each galaxy. Positive and negative \(\Phi_{50}\) values indicate, respectively, rising and declining recent SFH. Hexagonal bins summarize the median \(\Phi_{50}\) (upper panels) and local dispersion \(\sigma(\Phi_{50})\) (lower panels), requiring at least 10 galaxies per bin. title: A radio continuum view of Stephan's Quintet: age, dynamics and origin of the shock
comment: 25 pages, 13 Figures, Accepted for publication in ApJ
summary: We present a detailed, multi-band radio continuum study of the compact galaxy group Stephan's Quintet (HCG 92). We use a combination of new (MeerKAT, uGMRT) and archival (LOFAR, VLA) observations covering the $\rm 120\,MHz{-}8\,GHz$ frequency range to examine the radio properties of the group, focusing on the famous radio ridge and surrounding diffuse emission. We find filamentary substructure and branching in the southern half of the ridge, confirm an extension of the ridge to the northwest, and identify for the first time a radio counterpart to the gas bridge linking the ridge and NGC 7319. The northern ridge, northwest extension and diffuse emission have relatively steep, curved spectra, with a high-frequency spectral index gradient running north-south along the ridge. We show that the ridge emission primarily arises from a single physical mechanism, probably strong ($\mathcal{M}\simeq 40-100$) shocks in cold gas, caused by the $\rm \sim850-1000\,kms^{-1}$ collision between NGC 7318B and tidal gas filaments produced by past galaxy interactions. Synchrotron spectral age estimates suggest the collision began at the north end of the ridge $\rm \sim20\,Myr$ ago, and finished only $\rm \sim5-6\,Myr$ ago in the south, with the southern end of the shocked ridge likely still within or close to the disk of NGC 7318B. Based on this age gradient, we find that the angle between the intruder galaxy's motion and the tidal filaments was probably only about 15 degrees, and combining this with the lack of a spectral index gradient in the diffuse radio emission suggests that NGC 7318B's direction of motion is probably close to the line of sight.

title: Phase-Space Diagnostics for Dwarf Galaxies in Cluster Environments
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to ApJ, comments are welcome
summary: Ongoing effort is devoted to observing spectroscopic samples of dwarf galaxies in clusters, allowing the analysis of their distribution and associated trends in projected phase-space (PPS), i.e. line-of-sight velocity vs. projected clustercentric distance. By utilizing the resolved baryonic halos inside the galaxy clusters of a cosmological simulation from the Magneticum suite, we complement on prior studies with dedicated focus on the dwarf galaxy population ($M_\ast<10^9\,M_\odot$) and correlations between infall time and location in PPS. The inferred trend recovers the radial correlation reported by prior works, but we find a significant fraction ($\geq30\%$) of recently accreted galaxies at locations that were previously predicted to be dominated by ancient infallers. Splitting the diagram with an infall time threshold of 3 Gyr, we develop a detailed infall time template in PPS. We provide our data to allow observers to statistically infer the time of infall of their sample when placing them on the PPS. Additionally, we review the trajectories in PPS of different orbits and their dependence on the observer's orientation. Compared to massive galaxies, we find a much broader radial distribution for dwarfs in 3D PS. Utilizing a set of high-resolution idealized simulations, we predict strongly altered orbits for dark matter-deficient galaxies.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 目前正在进行大量工作，以观测星系团中矮星系的光谱样本，从而分析它们在投影相空间（PPS）中的分布及其相关趋势，即视线速度与投影星系团中心距离的关系。通过利用Magneticum宇宙学模拟中星系团内已解析的重子晕，我们补充了先前专注于矮星系族群（$M_\ast<10^9\,M_\odot$）以及PPS中落入时间与位置之间相关性的研究。推断的趋势重现了先前工作报道的径向相关性，但我们发现，在先前预测由古老落入者主导的区域中，有显著比例（$\geq30\%$）的近期吸积星系。以3 Gyr的落入时间阈值分割该图，我们开发了PPS中详细的落入时间模板。我们提供数据，使观测者能够将其样本置于PPS上时统计推断其落入时间。此外，我们回顾了不同轨道在PPS中的轨迹及其对观测者方向的依赖性。与大质量星系相比，我们发现矮星系在3D PS中的径向分布更宽。利用一组高分辨率理想化模拟，我们预测了暗物质缺乏星系的强烈改变的轨道。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要的AI结论：矮星系在PPS中的分布模式与大质量星系不同，单一的径向趋势不足以描述其掉入历史。构建的PPS掉入时间模板可作为观测工具，帮助研究者从观测数据中统计推断矮星系的掉入时间，为理解矮星系在星系团环境中的演化和吸积历史提供新视角。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Number density of projected phase-space distribution of Magneticum dwarf galaxies (grayscale background) compared to observed dwarf samples. The markers represent: Hydra [ 14 , blue circles,] , Perseus [ 60 , green pluses,] , Virgo [ 36 , violet triangles,] , and A85 [ 5 , pink diamonds,] . The adjacent histograms show the respective distributions of each sample.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：Magneticum矮星系的投影相空间分布的数密度（灰度背景）与观测到的矮星系样本的比较。标记代表：Hydra [14，蓝色圆圈]，Perseus [60，绿色加号]，Virgo [36，紫色三角形]和A85 [5，粉色菱形]。相邻的直方图显示了每个样本的相应分布。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Broadness of the local distribution of infall times across PPS. The cell color denotes the difference between the 84th and 16th percentile of the galaxies’ infall times in each cell. While the outer regions of the cluster have a relatively well defined mean due to small width, the inner parts ( \(R_{proj}<0.5{R}_{{200,c}}\) ) display a very large spread of infall times associated with these regions.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：PPS中局部落入时间分布的宽度。单元格颜色表示每个单元格中星系落入时间的第84百分位与第16百分位之间的差异。虽然星系团的外部区域由于宽度较小而具有相对明确的平均值，但内部区域（\(R_{proj}<0.5{R}_{{200,c}}\)）显示出与这些区域相关的非常大的落入时间散布。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Fraction of dwarf galaxies with recent infall ( \(<3\,Gyr\) ). While the cluster outskirts are almost entirely dominated by recently infallen galaxies, the cluster center does not only host ancient dwarfs, but also at least \(30\%\) of recently infallen galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：近期落入（\(<3\,Gyr\)）的矮星系比例。虽然星系团外围几乎完全由近期落入的星系主导，但星系团中心不仅包含古老矮星系，还包含至少\(30\%\)的近期落入星系。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Mean infall time into clusters for the dwarf galaxy population with recent vs. early accretion into cluster (left and right panel), differentiated by a threshold of \(3\text{\,}{Gyr}\) . The relative significance of the recent vs. early population in each region of PPS can be reviewed in Figure 3 . While recently infallen galaxies are spread smoothly throughout the cluster, once these are removed there is a strong trend of the early infallen galaxies even in the cluster outskirts. The data sets, as well as programs in Python and Julia for reproducing this template, are provided in a Github repository .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：矮星系族群中近期与早期吸积进入星系团的平均落入时间（左和右面板），以\(3\text{\,}{Gyr}\)的阈值区分。每个PPS区域中近期与早期族群的相对显著性可在图3中查看。虽然近期落入的星系在整个星系团中平滑分布，但一旦移除这些星系，即使在星系团外围，早期落入的星系也显示出强烈的趋势。用于重现此模板的数据集以及Python和Julia程序在Github仓库中提供。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Dark matter fraction of dwarf galaxies in PPS. The background shows the mean dark matter fraction of Magneticum dwarfs, while the black and light-orange lines show the percentiles of the dark matter-dominated and -deficient subsamples (dark matter fraction \(f_{DM}\gtrless 90\%\) ). The cyan lines represent the simulated TDG sample, while the cyan stars denote dark matter-deficient UDG observations: PUDG-R15 & -24 [ 22 ] , Yagi392 [ 6 , 17 ] , GMP2673 & 2552 [ 13 ] , Yagi090 & OGS1 [ 54 , 18 ] and UDG32 [ 28 ] . Dwarf galaxies with low dark matter fraction driven by tidal stripping are expected to be found mostly in the inner parts of the cluster \(R_{proj}/{R}_{{200,c}}\leq 0.5\) . If a dark-matter deficient galaxy is found at large clustercentric distances, it is likely formed via an alternative pathway, e.g. stripping of TDGs from a merger, which forms inherently dark matter-deficient galaxies in the cluster outskirts.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：PPS中矮星系的暗物质比例。背景显示Magneticum矮星系的平均暗物质比例，而黑色和浅橙色线显示暗物质主导和缺乏子样本的百分位数（暗物质比例\(f_{DM}\gtrless 90\%\)）。青色线代表模拟的TDG样本，而青色星号表示暗物质缺乏的UDG观测：PUDG-R15 & -24 [22]，Yagi392 [6, 17]，GMP2673 & 2552 [13]，Yagi090 & OGS1 [54, 18]和UDG32 [28]。由潮汐剥离驱动的低暗物质比例矮星系预计主要出现在星系团内部区域\(R_{proj}/{R}_{{200,c}}\leq 0.5\)。如果在大的星系团中心距离处发现暗物质缺乏的星系，它很可能通过替代途径形成，例如从并合中剥离TDG，这会在星系团外围形成本质上缺乏暗物质的星系。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: 3D Phase-space behavior of two simulated TDG samples with differing initial angular momentum (upper and lower row) compared to dwarf galaxies from a cosmological simulation. The background color of the left and middle column compare the distribution to giant and dwarf galaxies from Magneticum (10, 50 and 90% levels are shown as white solid lines, the dashed line indicates the local escape velocity), respectively, while the right column displays the orbit undertaken by the dark matter free TDG samples. The marker color shows the dwarf’s stellar halfmass radius at that moment, whereas the connecting lines indicate its time evolution over \(\sim\) \(4\text{\,}{Gyr}\) with timesteps of \(0.5\text{\,}{Gyr}\) (the motion is anticlockwise in the plane). Black marker color means less than six stellar particles for the given galaxy at that moment. Dwarf galaxies display a much larger spread in clustercentric distances compared to massive galaxies. The simulated dark matter-deficient galaxies acquire mostly constant radial velocities and decrease in stellar radius over time.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：两个具有不同初始角动量的模拟TDG样本（上排和下排）的3D相空间行为与来自宇宙学模拟的矮星系的比较。左列和中列的背景颜色分别将分布与Magneticum中的巨星系和矮星系（白色实线显示10、50和90%水平，虚线表示局部逃逸速度）进行比较，而右列显示无暗物质TDG样本所采取的轨道。标记颜色表示该时刻矮星系的恒星半质量半径，而连接线表示其在\(\sim\) \(4\text{\,}{Gyr}\)内的时间演化，时间步长为\(0.5\text{\,}{Gyr}\)（运动在平面内逆时针）。黑色标记颜色表示该星系在该时刻的恒星粒子少于六个。与巨星系相比，矮星系在星系团中心距离上显示出更大的散布。模拟的暗物质缺乏星系主要获得恒定的径向速度，并随时间减小恒星半径。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Top: Time evolution of circular and radial orbits in PPS. The line color corresponds to the observer icon color indicating the given projection. Bottom: Time evolution over \(4\text{\,}{Gyr}\) of baryon-dominated dwarfs inside a cluster under three different projections. A dwarf’s individual evolution is marked by black solid lines between the markers, where the color denotes its stellar halfmass radius and the timestep between two markers is \(0.5\text{\,}{Gyr}\) . Black marker color means less than six stellar particles for the given galaxy at that moment. The cartoon in the corner of each panel represents the projection direction. The green stars mark observations of dark matter-deficient UDGs. The background references the Magenticum dwarf galaxies. The simulated dark-matter deficient dwarf galaxies first move on diagonals characteristic for quasi-circular orbits, but evolve towards radial orbits in the end.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：顶部：PPS中圆形和径向轨道的时间演化。线条颜色对应于观测者图标颜色，指示给定的投影。底部：在三种不同投影下，星系团内重子主导矮星系在\(4\text{\,}{Gyr}\)内的时间演化。矮星系的个体演化由标记之间的黑色实线标记，其中颜色表示其恒星半质量半径，两个标记之间的时间步长为\(0.5\text{\,}{Gyr}\)。黑色标记颜色表示该星系在该时刻的恒星粒子少于六个。每个面板角落的卡通图表示投影方向。绿色星号标记暗物质缺乏的UDG观测。背景参考Magenticum矮星系。模拟的暗物质缺乏矮星系首先在准圆形轨道特征的对角线上移动，但最终演化为径向轨道。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8: Local distribution of infall times for each region in PPS. The lower grid contains the histogram for each gridcell denoted by the cellnumber shown in the upper PPS panel. Each cell is classified to belong to one of three classes (cartoon in the upper right), which differ in relative significance of recent vs. early infall, using a threshold of \(3\text{\,}{Gyr}\) (green line in histogram panels). The mean of the recent vs. early infallen population is indicated by the dashed lines in each panel. Almost the entirety of PPS displays multiple significant components in the infall time distributions. Only the very inner (outer) regions are dominated by mostly early (recently) infallen galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图8：PPS中每个区域的局部落入时间分布。下部网格包含每个网格单元的直方图，由上部PPS面板中显示的单元编号表示。每个单元被分类为三个类别之一（右上角的卡通图），这些类别在近期与早期落入的相对显著性上有所不同，使用\(3\text{\,}{Gyr}\)的阈值（直方图面板中的绿色线）。近期与早期落入族群的平均值在每个面板中用虚线表示。几乎整个PPS在落入时间分布中显示出多个显著成分。只有最内部（外部）区域主要由早期（近期）落入的星系主导。
